project_specification.project_name: nullius — Stage 0 BingX VST dry run: a synthetic book to would-send orders, no network
project_specification.addition_summary: Extend the router workspace member (packages/router, import name router) with a Stage 0 dry run that mirrors a book onto BingX's VST (demo) perpetual swap venue without touching the network. Everything upstream of the venue already exists: the book member publishes FinalTargetWeights (feature 305), and the router judges a submission against the venue's step and tick grids (312, require_rounded_order), its notional floor (313, require_min_notional), decides how it crosses (314, resolve_order_posture), settles it under isolated margin (315, require_isolated_margin) and folds its client order identifier (316, derive_client_order_id). What is missing is everything that turns a weight into a BingX order: BingX's contract document is not Binance's exchangeInfo (it carries quantityPrecision, pricePrecision, tradeMinQuantity and tradeMinUSDT rather than LOT_SIZE / PRICE_FILTER / NOTIONAL filters), nothing converts a target weight into a contract quantity, BingX limits clientOrderID to 40 characters while feature 316 derives 64 hex characters, and nothing assembles the judged pieces into the request BingX's POST /openApi/swap/v2/trade/order would receive. This addition builds those pieces as pure functions over recorded VST responses and a hand-written synthetic book, and ends in a command that prints the would-send orders and the refused legs. It sends nothing, signs nothing, reads no credential and opens no socket. Stage 1 (a signed VST client and the live-submission gate) is a separate, later spec.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace (members under packages/*, composed by src/app/module_loader.create_app) / SQLite stores addressed by DATABASE_URL / pytest (ruff conventions)
existing_context.test_baseline: workspace suite tests/ passing; member suites under packages/*/tests passing on main, including packages/router/tests (13 modules). Measure the real numbers by running the suite before relying on them.
existing_context.conventions: snake_case modules, frozen dataclasses for value types, stdlib-first members (a member adds no third-party lockfile edge unless it must), docstrings citing app_spec.xml feature numbers and docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md sections, refusals raised as typed errors whose message opens with a greppable code word and names the one repair, reject-never-round at the router's gates (an order is sized onto the grid where it is sized; 312 only judges it), @register only in a package __init__, cross-member imports deferred past module scope. Money and quantities are decimal.Decimal built from the venue's strings, never float arithmetic. Tests assert observed behaviour with narrative docstrings. Member suites and the workspace suite are run as separate pytest invocations (PYTHONPATH=src:packages/router/src for the member). The router's existing error vocabulary lives in router.errors (RouterFilterError, RouterOrderRoundingError, RouterBelowMinNotionalError, RouterOrderPostureError, RouterCrossMarginError, RouterClientOrderIdError). This addition's new refusals subclass router.errors.RouterError but are defined in the module that raises them, so parallel features never edit router.errors or router/__init__.py; callers import the new modules by full path.
existing_context.recorded_fixtures: packages/router/tests/fixtures/bingx_vst/ holds verbatim responses captured from open-api-vst.bingx.com (public endpoints, no key), trimmed to seven symbols; capture.json records host, time and requests. contracts.json is GET /openApi/swap/v2/quote/contracts: BTC-USDT, ETH-USDT, SOL-USDT, DOGE-USDT, 1000PEPE-USDT and AGLD-USDT have status 1; NCFXUSD2ARS-USDT has status 25 (not tradable) and no mark price. premium_index.json is GET /openApi/swap/v2/quote/premiumIndex (markPrice per symbol). synthetic_book.json is the hand-written Stage 0 book: book_id synthetic-vst-0, rebalance_ts 2026-09-30T00:00:00+00:00, account bingx-vst, margin_mode isolated, equity_usdt 10000, expected_fill_seconds 120, signed weights per symbol, decay_horizon_seconds per symbol, and positions {BTC-USDT: 0.0100}. These files are inputs: never edit them.

category.name: BingX VST Dry Run
category.feature: System translates a BingX swap contracts document into RouterSymbolFilters per symbol, taking the step size as ten to the minus quantityPrecision, the tick size as ten to the minus pricePrecision, min_qty from tradeMinQuantity and min_notional from tradeMinUSDT, and returns a not_tradable refusal naming the symbol when its status is not 1 or apiStateOpen is not "true". For the recorded fixture it returns BTC-USDT step 0.0001 tick 0.1, ETH-USDT step 0.001 tick 0.01 min_qty 0.001, and a not_tradable refusal for NCFXUSD2ARS-USDT. It also reads a BingX premiumIndex document into a Decimal mark price per symbol, returning a missing_mark_price refusal naming the symbol when a symbol the book holds has no mark price. For the recorded fixture it returns BTC-USDT 83137.3 and DOGE-USDT 0.09381.

System sizes final target weights into signed contract quantity deltas against RouterSymbolFilters and a Decimal mark per symbol: equity times weight divided by mark price, truncated toward zero onto the symbol's step grid, minus the position currently held. For the synthetic book it returns BTC-USDT +0.0140, ETH-USDT -0.558, SOL-USDT +8.44, DOGE-USDT -5329, 1000PEPE-USDT +69446 and AGLD-USDT +4.84, and a zero delta produces no order.

System projects the 64-hex client order identifier from feature 316 onto BingX's 40-character clientOrderID as the identifier's first 40 lowercase hex characters, returning the same projection for the same book_id, rebalance_ts and symbol and a client_order_id refusal for any value that is not a 64-hex identifier.

System assembles each sized delta into the parameters of a BingX POST /openApi/swap/v2/trade/order request by passing it through the router's existing gates in a fixed order: posture (314), step and tick grids (312), the notional floor (313), the minimum quantity, and isolated margin (315). A passive leg returns type LIMIT, timeInForce PostOnly and a price at the mark rounded onto the tick grid on the passive side (down for BUY, up for SELL). An aggressive leg returns type MARKET with no price, judged against the notional floor at the mark. A refused leg returns its router code word and the symbol instead of an order. It prints a dry-run plan from `python -m router.bingx_dry_run --book BOOK --contracts CONTRACTS --marks MARKS`, writing one JSON object per would-send order and one per refused leg to stdout, and exiting 0 while sending nothing. For the recorded fixtures and the synthetic book it returns five orders (BTC-USDT BUY 0.0140 LIMIT PostOnly 83137.3, ETH-USDT SELL 0.558 LIMIT PostOnly 2685.87, SOL-USDT BUY 8.44 LIMIT PostOnly 118.392, DOGE-USDT SELL 5329 MARKET, 1000PEPE-USDT BUY 69446 LIMIT PostOnly 0.0043199), a below_min_notional refusal for AGLD-USDT and a not_tradable refusal for NCFXUSD2ARS-USDT. Every clientOrderID it prints is at most 40 characters and equals feature 3's projection, and with socket creation patched to raise the command still exits 0, proving no connection is opened and no environment variable or credential is read.

project_specification.integration_points: Five new modules under packages/router/: bingx_documents.py, sizing.py, bingx_client_order_id.py, bingx_order.py and the bingx_dry_run.py entry point in src/router/, each committed as an empty stub so its file claim resolves, and their tests (also committed as empty stubs) beside the existing ones in packages/router/tests/. The dry run reads the synthetic book, publishes it through the book member's own book.final_target_weights so the weights arrive through feature 305's seam rather than as a bare dict, and never writes the rebalance store. Symbols keep BingX's hyphenated spelling (BTC-USDT) end to end; nothing maps them to Binance's BTCUSDT. The translator in feature 1 is a second, BingX-specific constructor of RouterSymbolFilters; nullius_ingest.exchange_info and router.exchange_info.resolve_router_filters stay Binance-shaped and unchanged. Feature 3's projection is a separate function over a ClientOrderId. router.client_order_id's 64-hex ClientOrderId, CLIENT_ORDER_ID_LENGTH and derive_client_order_id are unchanged, and the placement store's idempotency key stays the full 64-hex identifier. Posture reads the book's decay_horizon_seconds per symbol and its expected_fill_seconds. Margin settles under the book's isolated mode and account label. The router's rate limiter, retry, placement store and submission health are not called: nothing is placed.
project_specification.constraints: - Nothing in this addition opens a network connection, signs a request, reads an API key or secret, reads 1Password, or reads any environment variable. The new modules import no http.client, urllib.request, socket, ssl, hmac, ccxt, httpx, requests or aiohttp. - Stage 0 reads VST's own contract document. VST precisions and minimums differed from open-api.bingx.com's for 570 of 1185 shared symbols at capture, so a live-host document is never a stand-in for VST's. - Never read the contract's size field as the quantity step: it differs from ten to the minus quantityPrecision for ETH-USDT, SOL-USDT and five other symbols. - Quantities are truncated toward zero onto the step grid at sizing, so an order never exceeds its target. The router's gates still judge every order and never round one. - The fixtures under packages/router/tests/fixtures/bingx_vst/ are inputs and are never edited. Expected values are asserted exactly as Decimal strings. - router.client_order_id, router.exchange_info, router.rounding, router.notional, router.posture and router.margin keep their public behaviour. Their existing tests stay green unchanged. - router.errors and router/__init__.py are not edited. - No change to packages/ingest, packages/book's source, src/app/module_loader.py, the root pyproject.toml, uv.lock, migrations/** or settings. No new component is registered. - Do not edit docs/user-journeys/: verdicts there are set only by browser runs. - All existing workspace and member tests must stay green.

implementation_steps.step: Phase 1 — venue documents. Build the contracts translator and the mark-price reader (feature 1) in bingx_documents.py as pure functions over parsed JSON (bytes, str or mapping), each with its own typed refusal carrying a code word (not_tradable, missing_mark_price), tested against the recorded fixtures and against small inline documents for the refusal paths.

Phase 2 — sizing and identity. Build the weight-to-quantity sizer (feature 2) over FinalTargetWeights, equity, marks, filters and current positions, and the 40-character clientOrderID projection (feature 3) over router.client_order_id.ClientOrderId.

Phase 3 — order assembly and the plan. Chain the existing gates in the fixed order of feature 4, add the minimum-quantity check as a new refusal (below_min_quantity) defined in bingx_order.py, emit BingX order parameters (symbol, side, positionSide BOTH, type, quantity, price, timeInForce, clientOrderID) as strings, and add the python -m router.bingx_dry_run entry point with its socket-patched end-to-end test.
